decisions.oneAssessableCompetence: Design a buffer recipe satisfying a stated pH interval and finite acid/base-load constraints.
decisions.ownCurrentScientificReason: Recipe composition and permissible finite loads constrain the same design: a recipe succeeds only while both rest amounts remain positive and the resulting ratio stays within the allowed band. The load calculation is the design acceptance criterion, not an independent routine requiring a split. This is finite-tolerance design, not an unstated demand for differential beta or laboratory manufacture.
decisions.separabilityAndRemainingBoundary: Existing atomic FIRST reason remains scientifically applicable and the current wording is more precise. a449 supplies pH calculation as prerequisite. No actual production, universal pH-independent capacity or observed performance is inferred.
